label: Patch banks (.syx, .h2p, .zip)
description: Your own patches: Prophet-5 / Prophet-10 Rev 4 SysEx program banks, u-he Repro-5 patches, or zips of either. They appear on the BANKS page, one bank per file, and the first 90 also appear in the PRESET menu as U01-U90.
hint: The plugin reads the banks folder when it loads: remove Profit-5 from the track and add it again (or reopen the project) after uploading. Loose files must sit in banks/ itself; a zip may contain folders.

rules.label: Zip of .syx / .h2p files
rules.note: A zip; the plugin reads the .syx and .h2p files inside it when it loads, and the BANKS page shows how many it found.
